Frequently Asked Questions

We try to offer a quick and seamless application process keeping your time and ongoing commitments in mind.

To apply for open positions, visit our careers website at talentsprint.com/careers. Complete the application form, and if shortlisted, you'll be contacted for interviews with the immediate manager, business head, and HR. The timeframe of the entire process differs from position to position.

Our core values drive us to deliver excellence and innovation, always keeping our customers at the heart of our mission.

  • Customer Comes First: We’re all about our customers. Every decision we make is centered around delivering exceptional value to them. We listen, adapt, and evolve to meet their ever-changing needs.
  • Quality in Everything: Excellence is our standard. From design to delivery, we ensure top-notch quality in all we do. Continuous improvement is in our DNA – we innovate, optimize, and eliminate inefficiencies to maintain the highest standards.
  • Innovation for Scale: Creativity and calculated risks drive us. We encourage experimentation to develop new solutions, streamline operations, and stay ahead of the curve. Leveraging technology and trends, we aim for growth and adaptability in every challenge.

Our company culture is one-of-a-kind. It is inclusive, collaborative, and transparent. Despite 13+ years in business, we maintain a flat, startup-like structure that embraces open communication and equity.

  • Inclusion: We celebrate diverse voices and backgrounds, ensuring everyone feels welcome and valued.
  • Transparency: With an open-door policy, you can freely share your thoughts and ideas with leaders or colleagues.
  • Collaboration: We work together to achieve your and our goals, creating a supportive and innovative environment., teams work cohesively, cross departmental collaboration high
  • Open Communication: Our flat hierarchy encourages direct communication and open dialogue across all levels. Learning and Growth - Open Communication
  • Empowerment: We empower you to grow by offering various Learning & Development opportunities and the freedom to exercise your ideas in innovative ways.
  • Employee Well-Being: We prioritize employee well-being and create a work environment where they can thrive personally and professionally.

In our organization, we’re always looking out for you and your well-being.

We’ve got a robust health and life insurance plan that covers you and your family. Our retirement plan is pretty sweet too, with a company match to help you build a secure financial future.

But it doesn’t stop there—we’ve also got flexible work hours, wellness programs to keep you feeling your best, and plenty of mentoring opportunities and programs to support your professional growth.

We’re here to support your growth, both personally and professionally, while helping you keep a great work-life balance.

More About Us

Founded in 2009, TalentSprint, a part of Accenture, is a global deeptech education company powered by AI that brings transformational bootcamps and innovative learning programs to modern-day professionals who aspire to future-proof themselves with deep expertise. TalentSprint partners with top-tier academic institutions and big tech global corporations to create futuristic programs and deliver remarkable outcomes. Its AI-powered platform ipearl.ai, seamlessly blends world-class academic rigor with industry-leading practitioner experience.
